title: Spike-Aware INT8 Execution for Spiking Language Models on Commodity CPUs
abstract: arXiv:2606.03026v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Binary spike activations allow a language-model runtime to read only active weight columns and replace multiplications by weight sums. We implement this execution strategy in C++ for an 874M-parameter spike-gated language model. Sparse projections use column-major INT8 weights, integer accumulation, and one scale application per output channel; dense projections retain row-major access and FP32 activations. In a single-thread comparison using an early checkpoint, INT8 achieves 23.31 tokens/s versus 9.82 for FP32, while reducing weight storage from 3355.2 to 1087.4 MiB. A variant using INT4 on dense projections saves a further 17.4% of storage but reduces decode throughput by 46.6%. On an AMD Ryzen 7 5800X, the final INT8 checkpoint achieves 22.63 tokens/s on one thread and 47.90 on four threads; 512-token prefill reaches 94.68 tokens/s on eight threads. A separate ARM output-head case study records higher trimmed decode-window

translated_title: 面向商用CPU的脉冲感知INT8执行方案：用于脉冲语言模型
translated_abstract: 二值脉冲激活使语言模型运行时只需读取活跃的权重列，并用权重求和替代乘法运算。我们使用C++为874M参数的脉冲门控语言模型实现了这一执行策略。稀疏投影采用列主序INT8权重、整数累加以及每个输出通道一次的缩放应用；稠密投影则保留行主序访问和FP32激活。在使用早期检查点的单线程对比中，INT8达到23.31 tokens/s，而FP32仅为9.82 tokens/s，同时将权重存储从3355.2 MiB降至1087.4 MiB。在稠密投影上使用INT4的变体可再节省17.4%的存储空间，但会使解码吞吐量降低46.6%。在AMD Ryzen 7 5800X上，最终的INT8检查点在单线程下达到22.63 tokens/s，四线程下达到47.90 tokens/s；512 token的预填充在八线程下达到94.68 tokens/s。另一项独立的ARM输出头案例研究记录了更高的截断解码窗口（原文此处似乎截断）。
tldr: 该论文针对脉冲语言模型提出了一种脉冲感知的INT8量化执行策略，在商用CPU上实现了相比FP32快2倍以上的推理速度，同时将权重存储减少约68%。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a spike-aware INT8 execution strategy for spiking language models on commodity CPUs, achieving over 2x faster inference than FP32 while reducing weight storage by approximately 68%.
